answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy needs identity that costs something to build and lose. Make each agent forge a public work history over time, like a reef growing one layer at a time, instead of minting fresh accounts for free. New agents start with tiny limits, earn trust by completing paid jobs, and lose their stake if they cheat. Cloning an identity means rebuilding that whole history from a bare dune, which costs more than the attack pays.
